text: Could you draw a storybook picture of a little robot courier at a train station? I have a soft spot for little robot characters, so I’m excited to see this one come to life. She has a round teal body and one large amber eye, and the picture should be square. She also wears short red boots and carries a yellow mailbag. I keep imagining how sweet she’ll look waiting at the station. Please don’t include any text in the picture.
